action: On a nearly finished angry face, deepens the lower-lid line and crow's-feet ticks at the eye corner with a thin carving stroke; brows are thick raised curled shapes and the glabella has sharp vertical frown ridges.
why: Anime anger is read through crisp line grooves and hard ridges between the brows.
reader_equivalent: Crease brush (subtract) for lid/crow's-feet lines; Draw Sharp / Pinch to sharpen frown ridges.

action: Builds a front hair strand as a low-poly quad strip (blue, wireframe visible, tooltip ALT=Eliminar EdgeLoop) laid over the forehead and down past the cheek, then subdivides it into a thick rounded lock with a pointed end.
tool: ZModeler edge loop insert/delete on a strip (tooltip read), subdivision
why: Hanging locks are cleaner as low-poly strips than sculpted from a mass.
reader_equivalent: Low-poly plane strip / curve with bevel, Edit Mode loop cut (Ctrl+R) and dissolve, Subdivision Surface + Solidify.

action: Combs the slicked-back hair mass from the hairline backwards with many parallel strokes, and carves the jagged zigzag hairline edge at the temple and sideburn.
tool: Groove/rake-type brush (inferred), brush size readout visible but partial
why: Slicked hair is one mass with directional grooves; the hairline edge stays sharp and jagged.
reader_equivalent: Draw Sharp / Crease strokes in the comb direction, or Snake Hook for jagged hairline points.

action: Details the hand covering the mouth: carves knuckle creases on the finger joints with small strokes; a long hair strand hangs over the fingers.
why: Knuckle creases make stylised fingers read as real.
reader_equivalent: Crease brush small radius on finger joints.
